reviews.text:
UPDATE 10/16/2026:

I continue to be impressed by the staff every time I visit! Everyone is so sweet and takes amazing care of my babies!!  They are so accommodating, 10/10 recommend!! Thank yall for everything you do!

PREVIOUS:
I’d like to give a huge shout-out and huge THANK YOU to Dr. Reyff and Cassidy, her vet tech, who always go above and beyond for my little Coco. They’re personable, knowledgeable, and quick to accommodate. My chihuahua has had anal gland issues over the past month and had an abscess pop up over night and they were able to squeeze us in last minute on a Saturday due to the urgency of the situation. Forever grateful for the team here!!

I also appreciate their honesty and the way they offer different options, starting with smaller, preventative steps when they know I may not have the budget for major procedures. And I love how excited they always are to see Coco and how gently and thoughtfully they take care of her.

You can truly see how much they care in their service and treatment plans. I’m always grateful every time we visit!
Staff is very friendly. Prices are decent. Smooth and easy vet visits. I would highly recommend this place to all.
Thank you for your 5-star review!

We had a great experience today!  Ishani is the best vet!  Super knowledgeable and professional.  The staff was very welcoming and friendly. My dog was very comfortable, I don't think she wanted to leave.  The clinic was clean and the technology was up to date!  Great Visit!
Every time I go here I know my girl is loved, and she can be difficult at times. Everyone here truly cares about the animals they help. I truly appreciate everything CityVet does for my pup and me.

My dog had diarrhea for about two weeks, including a week that I was on vacation, and she was at the kennel. I gave a very good description of the issues she had with her GI tract, and had the appointment the same day. I love that you could book the appointments online and provide details without having to pick up the phone

There was absolutely no wait when I came in, was seen right away, the staff is very caring, they do follow up with you about your pet! Easy checkout, you check out right in the room versus the front desk, easy email and text message follow up the next day and following days. They filled a prescription and within a few hours I had it in hand!

I found them to be reasonably priced given what was going on with my dog, I’m sure there are more cost-effective options, but for the care that the staff gave me and my dog, it’s absolutely worth it. I’m someone who sees no harm in paying more for absolutely amazing service.

I definitely will be back with any more concerns, thank you so much!

Found a flea on my cat and called them asking if they did flea dips.  Receptionist said they offered Cap- something pill, and it’s only a single dose, and they sold it over the counter!  Picked it up!
They really care so much and are so patient. Super grateful that my dog and cat are under their care. I just always know they are in the right hands. 🧡
From walking in the door until I left with a happier, healthier dog, the service and professionalism was first-class
We had such a lovely experience, all of the techs were nice, and the doctor was so knowledgeable. And the first visit was free!! That was such a blessing! Definitely will give them my business!

The team at CityVet consistently cares for our pup like he is their own. Our dog gets into all sorts of trouble, but we always know that we can bring him to CityVet and he will be well cared for and loved on, and that we will get accurate diagnosis quickly.

We have been patients of Dr Awasthi for a year or so now, and she really takes the time necessary to hear our concerns, talk us through what is going on, and ensure we know all of our options.

The front desk always makes us feel like family, and could not be friendlier.

All around, we can say that CityVet is the best vet we have ever visited, and we will be patients there for years to come.

Thank you, CityVet team!
All around 5 stars! Dr. C and staff are amazing and took care of our pup Beaux. We will forever be returning! Thank you.
Dr. C and staff were absolutely amazing!
Dr. Awasthi and Dr. McGuire were very kind and caring and accommodating. They both worked me in last minute and even followed up to check on my dog after surgery. You can tell they love animals.
The vet is amazing—knows everything there is to know about the good health of my pets and can talk about literature to boot. What’s not to love?! The whole staff at this location is patient and kind.

This was my first time taking my dog Fibo to this clinic and saw Dr. McGuire for an annual check up and vaccines. Dr. McGuire and his staff were extremely nice and professional. They took amazing care of my dog. He unfortunately had a slightly bad reaction to the vaccine and I took him back to see them. They were extremely helpful and took amazing care of my dog. I highly recommend this clinc and will definitely be taking my dog back here.
Thank you, Colleen, for taking the time to leave a review. We appreciate your support!
Thank you for your 5-star review!
Thank you, Victoria, for taking the time to leave a review. Your feedback is appreciated!

I’d like a call from the clinic manager to discuss how Dr. Lettsome failed to diagnose my poor dog with pneumonia at two different opportunities. My dog nearly died because she didn’t take his cough seriously.

Update: a year later, and I still despise Dr. Lettsome. She was rude, abrasive, and refused to apologize in any way for letting my dog nearly die.

Update: two years later, still despise Dr. Lettsome.

If you see great reviews for Dr. Dill—yes, she was great, and she no longer works here.

Would be great if you could take my dog’s name off of your response, CityVet.

Love Dr.McGuire! City Vet is the best! Our 13 year old cat, Joey had a large mass on his tail. Dr. McGuire removed the mass, as well as his tail. He did an amazing job and Joey healed nicely.  Dr. McGuire and the rest of staff took amazing care of Joey and while he was boarded. Thank you City Vet at Lover’s Lane!

Dr Chandrasekar literally saved my 15 year old dog from dying of pyrometra. They got me in next day for surgery that was reasonably priced. The odds of making it out of surgery were slim considering her age. She called right when it was finished and gave me the best news of my life. She is recovering perfectly. After surgery from this doctor she acts like a puppy again and her surgery scar is perfectly straight and so well done. I will never go to another vet. All the staff are super empathetic and so nice and personable. Thank you for saving my dogs life!

I have had nothing but great experiences here. Affordable, reliable, and usually available same day without the price tag of an emergency vet. Dr. Mike McGuire is so caring and attentive. Sends follow up emails after visits and does thorough exams. Really convenient location as well as my puppy loves the staff.
The Dr. and team was patient and kind. Got a lovely written summary from doc of appointment discussions and details
Thank you, Janeth, for taking the time to leave a review. We appreciate your support!
Thank you for your 5-star review!

I was worried about my cat having asthma and needed essentially the same day appointment which they managed to do. Anytime I have how to worry and requested for a quick appointment. They've always managed to squeeze me at. Dr. McGuire is the best, he sends me an email summary and our game plan in the future after every visit, he went to a conference where they suggested distilled water to combat cats with urinary tract issues and instead of waiting until our next visit to tell me he called me and left a detailed message, he didn't have to do that. Every vet tech has always been amazing. I absolutely love using them as a vet. Bear bear had a few doctors before McGuire who were also phenomenal. I just ended up liking him the most. Cannot recommend this place more.

We love the City Vet - Greenville/Lovers Lane office. They always take fantastic care of Jane and she looks, feels, and smells fantastic after every grooming session. We are happy to have found such a wonderful groomer and Vet for her.

Dr. McGuire is the best. Our dog Penny has been struggling with anxiety. Dr. McGuire made thoughtful recommendations and even reached out to his colleague for expert advice. He then called us to give an update from his colleague - while he was on vacation! He cares the animals he treats and it shows.
They were friendly and attentive. Got me in the next day, and the prices were good. The vet tech we worked with was especially sweet.
The staff is great and professional.They give my dog a lot love and attention and she loves it.

What a wonderful experience to find this vet clinic! (It was an answered prayer, really!)  My brother and his wife recommended CitiVet and my twin sister and I loved meeting Dr. Ishani Awashti and her vet tech, Valerie, today!  (Everyone at the office was friendly and welcoming.)  What compassionate and competent care they provided to "Kitty Gwen"! They showed so much wisdom, expertise, kindness and patience and I recommend that any pet be seen at this lovely and clean facility. They deserve 10 stars! God bless you all! I will be back. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Been with Cityvet for a little over a year now. Best care we have had in Texas so far. All the staff and the vets are so caring and accommodating anytime of day. Have had questions and last minute vet appts needed and they squeeze us in with no problem.

An absolute incredible team! One of the best teams for furbabies in Dallas! They are always willing to help always kind always thorough always professional! Absolutely unmatched professional! Thank you guys so much for everything you have no idea how much better I sleep knowing the care my babies will receive when needed♥️
very quick and efficient! the staff was very friendly and gave good advice. we trust them completely with our new baby kitten!

Efficient and friendly. My older cat just got diagnosed with kidney disease and the dr explained everything with detail, they provided learning material and even samples of the special cat food so we can decide what is best for our girl. The prices were also reasonable. We are very thankful.

Never been to this location. Friendly greeting when I walked in, they got me right into a room,  nurse & Dr. McGuire were both very personable and answered all my questions. Didn’t try to sell me extra tests or products i didn’t need which I always appreciate. Would go back!

I brought my very first puppy to his first vet visit here today. It was such a calm, smooth and lovely experience. Everything from being checked in, escorted to our room to the nurse tech taking Snickerdoodle to get her shots and fecal sample. Dr. Wang brought him back to me, we chatted about a few things and that was it. We are doing the Puppy Package and booked our next round of shots on the spot. Thank you Team City Vet Lovers!

We visited this location when we found a kitten crawling in the road at a busy intersection, seemingly with injured back legs. We take our own dog to the White Rock location. Sadly, when we showed up to the Lovers location the woman working seemed uninterested in helping in what was a time sensitive situation. She even suggested we take the injured kitten to Veterinary Emergency Group instead. We decided to call the White Rock location and they told us to bring him there. We took him in to be examined and cared for. Kitten is now doing great…thanks to the White Rock staff.

The staff here took great care of our two cats. One is extra spicy and difficult to work with, and the kindness shown by the team here was incredible. They were eager to help and worked with a very challenging and anxious kitty to make sure she was treated comfortably. We appreciated how open and transparent the staff was about pricing before we make decisions, and their non-judgmental attitude towards treatment and pet history. We loved seeing the team at CityVet!
They take great care of my babies!

We have used CityVet numerous times.  While recently on vacation, we received a call that our 16 1/2 year old long-haired Dachshund (Sammy) was not doing well. Dr. McGuire kept us apprised of his condition. On our return home we received a call from him that Sammy had passed away.  Through this experience Dr. McGuire was compassionate and said they would meet us at any time.  Laura, the Branch Manager brought Sammy to us and was filled with sympathy and concern beyond measure.  This place is amazing! Do not hesitate for one moment to leave your precious pet in their care.

CHEW Clinic saved our dog's life! Our local vet hospital gave us an estimate between $6000-$8000 to spay our dog that had a pyrometra infection. That price was beyond our means at the time and time was of the essence. We were blessed to find CHEW that was not only able to fit us into their scheduled surgery calendar, but also at the fraction of the estimated charges. The surgery went very well and our dog recovered quickly. They were caring, professional and more importantly worked with us to do what was best for our pet. THANK YOU! Thank you also to all the donors that keep facilities like this available to all those in need. God bless you!

I brought my fur baby around February 2025. I found my fur baby Enzo out in the streets and took him in hands for almost a year. After deciding to get him checked up, a friend referred me to CityVet. Was the great choice ever made! 😊 The doctors and front desk staff were so helpful throughout the process and very sweet. I’ve brought my pet multiple times here and they are able to help with any questions you have. Though my dog is always very nervous walking in, they are very patient with him and handle with care. ❤️❤️❤️🐶🐶

There are not enough positive things for me to say about this practice. Everyone I’ve come across here loves animals so deeply and it’s so clear in the way they care for their patients. I have a scared, reactive rescue dog and they love her SO much. They always reassure me that she’s no trouble, and there are some people there who really have a heart for the tough cases. I’ve never been made to feel like she is any different than any other pup they see even though she can be a handful. I trust them with her care implicitly because they absolutely treat her like she’s one of their own. They set me at ease every time we visit or board.

Staff is friendly, efficient & professional.
My dog is happy & tail wagging when
we visit, & the front desk ladies smile
& greet my dog by her name.
Peppy went in for his booster and drags me into the vet each time. He loves the vets there. Very professional.
Really appreciate the care and sensitivity with my very scared dog after being attacked by 2 other dogs.

I do not take any delight in leaving this review, as I’m very heartbroken to have lost my dog Mosley and heartbroken that he passed under the circumstances this vet had him endure. I’ve been with city vet for years. I took Mosley in to see the doctor as he was having extend pain in his rear legs and could not even use the restroom. The vet informed me it was likely his knee or arthritis. His conditions continued to deteriorate and I brought him back. The vet performed an x-ray and said it was his knee. He suggested surgery but said it wouldn’t be for sure if it would fix the problem. I asked him to give my dog pain killers to help with his extreme pain. He told me he was not in pain and gave him muscle relaxers.

The following Monday, I took him to a different vet. They did more than simply x-ray his legs and sent him on the way. My poor Mosley had a cancerous tumor in his spine, was in enormous amounts of unbearable pain, and the cancer had spread to the point it was inoperable. They gave him a shot to relieve him of his pain so I could have 24 hours to say my goodbye to my precious Mosley. Attached is the text from the vet at cityvet who suggested surgery on his knee.

I’d prefer not to get the generic response as you have given others to call you. You have my name and my dog’s name. I’ll spare you the pain of hearing the heartbreak and needless suffering my dog went through at the expense of your vet. I’d also suggest you train your veterinarians to learn empathy and compassion. These are our beloved dogs, they are not deserving of the lack of professionalism and compassion your company provides.

This is a very caring and wonderful clinic. Jordan was so concerned about my Daisy over the phone.She went above and beyond to help me. She even called back to make sure that I was taken care of. 🥰🐶❤️ …

I love this vet! They’re reasonably priced, I can always get a same or next day appointment, they will walk through treatment options and prices. I’m an over protective dog mom and the vet and techs are always happy to answer and explain any questions or concerns I have and don’t oversell you on products or services you don’t need. I sometimes drop my dog off for several hours to be groomed and I feel very comfortable leaving her with their staff

Fantastic experience! The staff and doctors here are incredibly kind, attentive, and clearly passionate about animals. They also brightened our day with their thoughtful touches (look what an amazing envelope!) :). Highly recommend!
I loved it...the doctor was very kind and all the staff were very professional and quickly diagnosed my kitten's problem...very caring with animals. 100% recommended, plus the prices are reasonable.
The doctors and staff are amazing!  We recently had to put down our lab and they were all so kind and thoughtful.  They made a very sad and painful experience a little easier.  Thank you!

I have a senior dog(15 yrs). I’ve had 3 visits with them so far. Check up, dental cleaning, and seizure episodes. Each time they have been really great. They are upfront about treatments and costs and don’t pressure you into anything. Only suggestions. Dr. Dill did his dental cleaning and they texted and updated me basically every hour, which I appreciated so much. I saw their other vet, he is also very knowledgeable. All their staff, including front desk and techs are kind and sweet. Definitely recommend going here.

We appreciate your feedback, Jhara, and we’re sorry to hear that your experience didn't meet your expectations. Your satisfaction is important to us, and we’d love the opportunity to speak with you about your concerns to make things right. We did reach out to the number listed on the account. Would you be able to give us a call at your convenience for us to further investigate your concerns and experience. Our number is (469) 872-7555 and please ask to speak with the manager.

I took a kitten to the City Vet on Wednesday, June 11,2025. I took there around 2:45 PM and waited for over two hours to see a vet. By this time, the vet office was closing. I told vet about extreme diarrhea symptoms and that I was using syringe to feed kitten around the clock.
The kitten’s diarrhea was not improving, it was getting worse and the kitten was not gaining weight. Vet took weight, temp, and recommended a stool sample to be brought the next day, Thursday, June 12, 2025 to the City Vet on Lovers Lane.
The kitten weight that day was lower than earlier in the week. The kitten’s temperature was lower than earlier in the week. The kitten was struggling. I took stool sample next morning to vet along with kitten. I mentioned to the vet that the kitten’s stool was so runny that it went into the pad and there was nothing to collect. I did try and brought what I could collect. The next morning around 8:20 AM the kitten and I went into the vet and the vet took the temp, lower than day prior, took weight, lower than he day before. Again, I mentioned about diarrhea being extreme. The vet said the stool sample  was negative.
The vet said no hospital needed, just continue feeding and continue to take the parasite meds.
Vet said no  hospital needed. The kitten died Friday June 13, 2025 in morning. I am fairly certain this death was caused by diarrhea and dehydration. I feel that this could have been prevented with a subcutaneous liquids application.  None was offered or recommended. Vet gave me an appointment for the following Friday, June 20, 2021.
I feel that information and evidence was presented for two days which should not have been ignored and dismissed. This kitten needed diarrhea addressed over all other symptoms. The vet concentrated on parasites and not the diarrhea which is what killed the kitten. On internet, the kitten should not have diarrhea for over two days otherwise it becomes fatal. This vet was informed about severe diarrhea on the first meeting. This was a mis diagnosis and a fatal one.
We love CityVet on Lovers Lane. The staff is always so welcoming. They answer all questions and provide tips and tricks. They have made starting off with a new puppy easier.
I've taken my pets here for the last couple years and the staff are always so nice. I recommend them to everyone I know that have pets

Extremely friendly and helpful staff! Plus, very reasonable prices! I was looking to get a health certificate to fly with my dog and they charge the best rate in the area (about half the amount of my previous vet). They also looked after my pup for a few extra minutes while I ran next door to grab a coffee! I was so impressed and plan to return!

I have taken my 3 pets here & always felt like they were well cared for.  Today, I brought my female cat in for some bloodwork so she could have her teeth cleaned.  Imagine my surprise when the doctor came in & said her teeth looked very good & we could wait- not to waste the money on it now.  In a world run by big corporations, this made me feel like I wasn’t being treated as just a bottom line figure.  Thank you for the honesty as I have had some very costly vet bills over the past 2 years for my dog.
Thank you! 🫶🏻 …
Best staff in Dallas.  I’ve been going to City Vet for as long as I can remember and they keep getting better.

I have been going to city vet for year for my 7 year old pup. We’ve had our ups and downs with issues. This time I did not appreciate being told one price for something over the phone and then checking out being $50 more. Also not telling me that a booster shot would cost another $57 in 2 weeks. I really want to find a better and trustworthy vet.

Very friendly and pleasant staff.  I love how the vet and the nurses spend plenty of time with you and the fur babies.  Zero rush or pressure and they are very attentive to every concern.  Definitely a very pleasant experience and appreciate everyone here!
Great staff!!! Always taken VERY GOOD care on my little angel.

I love the staff here! Everyone is friendly, professional, helpful and really seems to have my pets best interests and care for their patients. I’ve never had a bad experience here, never feel over charged or over sold and I do regular grooming, yearly check-ups and teeth cleanings here.
I’ve taken my cat to this clinic twice and both times I got a quick appointment and received great care. I would recommend this location.
Such a great experience from start to finish. The vet nurse was amazing and the fill in vet was wonderful. They both treated my babies with love and care. We will be back!

The staff here is great and I cannot recommend Dr. Dill highly enough. Extremely knowledgeable, patient, and kind. She’s great with my pet- and with me! She always takes the time to answer all of my questions and provides exceptional care to my pet. I just love her. She’s the best doctor we’ve ever had. I would make her my beneficiary, protect her from harm, write a review, whatever. You’re making a good choice coming here to see her.
Dr Dill & the entire staff is wonderful. Dr Dill was so kind & caring to my very nervous & scared dog. She really gain my dogs trust by the end of our visit.
My dog sees Dr. Dill, and she is so kind, caring a thoughtful with my dog’s care. She takes the time to explain different treatment options to ensure my dog is happy and healthy. Highly recommend!
I started using city vet as an option when my rover sitter is booked. I feel secure knowing she’s being cared for by a vet in case of emergencies.

I’m always able to get an appointment in same day or next day and the staff is so helpful! Everyone is so friendly and genuinely wants the best for my dog. This is my first pet I’ve owned in Dallas, and I would recommend this vet as a great place for you if you’re not sure where to take your new pet.

I highly recommend this place, I brought my dog here for dental surgery and everything went great from my initial phone call to
picking him up from surgery. The whole staff is great and Dr. Dill really cares for your pet!
Everyone was so friendly and professional!
